title: Dynamic Type across app chrome
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Accessibility > Dynamic Type as the base
acceptance: Every .system(size:) call site outside the reader text stack is replaced with a Dynamic Type equivalent
Layouts hold at Accessibility XL without clipping or truncation in the library, sheets, cards, sidebar, and share extension
